scheme_name: Scheme name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
scope: Scope: Central Sector / Centrally Sponsored crop insurance scheme
ministry: Ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
purpose:
PMFBY provides crop insurance cover to farmers against yield losses due to non-preventable
natural risks such as drought, flood, pest attack, and other notified perils, as defined
in the scheme guidelines for the insured season and crop.
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas can enroll, including loanee and non-loanee farmers, subject to state / season notifications.
Enrollment is typically done through banks, Common Service Centres (CSCs), insurance company channels, or the PMFBY portal as notified for the season.
Coverage applies only for crops and areas notified for that season by the state government.
benefits: Financial compensation for yield loss assessed under the scheme methodology for the insured crop and area.
Premium rates for farmers are subsidized as per the scheme design; the balance premium is shared by Central and State Governments according to the prevailing guidelines.
Exact sum insured, premium, and cut-off dates are season-specific and published in official notifications.
documents: Land records / sowing certificate as applicable
Bank account details and Aadhaar as required by the enrollment channel
Crop and survey / village details for the notified area
limits: Farmers should confirm the current season's notified crops, cut-off dates, and premium on https://pmfby.gov.in/ or the state agriculture portal before enrollment.
This summary is for citizen guidance from publicly described scheme information and does not replace the official operational guidelines.

eligibility_rules.note: loanee and non-loanee farmers may enroll when other conditions hold

scheme_name: Scheme name: Shakti Scheme (also referred to as Shakti Yojana)
ministry: Department: Transport Department, Government of Karnataka
portals: Official citizen portals: https://sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in/ and https://www.myscheme.gov.in/
overview: Karnataka Shakti Scheme (Free Bus Travel for Women)
purpose:
The Shakti scheme provides free travel for eligible women passengers on participating
state-run bus services in Karnataka. It is a state government welfare scheme intended
to improve women's mobility and access to education, work, and essential services.
eligibility: Women citizens of Karnataka are the intended beneficiaries for free travel under the scheme.
Travel is available on participating Karnataka State Road Transport Corporation (KSRTC) and other notified state transport buses as per government notifications.
Beneficiaries should follow the latest official rules for proof of identity when required by conductors or transport authorities.
Men are not eligible for free travel under this scheme.
Rules for children, special categories, and exclusions are as notified by the Transport Department from time to time.
benefits: Zero fare for eligible women passengers on notified routes and participating bus services.
Applies to ordinary / notified categories of state buses as per the government order; premium or excluded services (if any) follow the latest official notification.
procedure: Eligible women may board participating buses and travel without paying the ordinary fare, subject to verification rules published by the Transport Department.
For grievance redressal, route information, or scheme clarifications, citizens should use Seva Sindhu or the Transport Department's official channels.
Always verify the latest eligibility and bus categories on official government portals before travel, because notifications may be updated.
documents: Government-issued photo identity proof may be requested (for example Aadhaar or other accepted ID), as per current conductor / transport guidelines.
No separate online application is required merely to board for free travel when the scheme is active and the passenger is eligible, unless a future notification says otherwise.
limits: This note summarizes publicly described scheme information for citizen assistance.
Exact fare exemptions, bus categories, and identity checks follow the latest Government of Karnataka Transport Department notification.
Official sources: Seva Sindhu (https://sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in/), myScheme (https://www.myscheme.gov.in/), and Karnataka Transport Department publications.

scheme_name: Scheme name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
ministry: Ministry / Department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
overview: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) - Scheme Overview (Central Government)
benefits: Accidental death: Rs 2 lakh (two lakh rupees) sum insured
Permanent total disability due to accident: Rs 2 lakh
Permanent partial disability due to accident: Rs 1 lakh (as per scheme schedule)
limits: Annual premium is Rs 20 per member per year (subject to official notifications)
Premium is typically auto-debited from the linked bank account
eligibility: Indian citizens in the eligible age band as notified (commonly 18 to 70 years)
Must have a savings bank account and give consent for auto-debit
One cover per eligible member through a participating bank
procedure: Claims require bank facilitation and prescribed documents such as claim form, KYC, and accident/death proof as applicable Source note: Official Central Government social security scheme (PMSBY) under the Jan Suraksha umbrella administered with Department of Financial Services. Last curated for GramSakhi grounding: operational facts commonly published on official DFS / Jan Suraksha materials.

ministry: Department: Women and Child Development / Government of Karnataka guarantee schemes
overview: Gruha Lakshmi (Gruha Lakshmi Scheme) - Government of Karnataka
benefits: Eligible woman head of the family receives Rs 2,000 (two thousand rupees) per month
Assistance is transferred to the beneficiary bank account (DBT)
eligibility: Woman must be a resident of Karnataka
Woman should be the head of the family (or recognized as such under scheme rules)
Family should belong to the eligible category as notified by the Government of Karnataka
Applicant should have a valid Aadhaar-linked bank account for Direct Benefit Transfer
Only one woman per family is generally eligible under the scheme norms
documents: Family / ration card details as required on Seva Sindhu / department portal
procedure: Applications are commonly submitted through Seva Sindhu (sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in) and related Karnataka e-governance channels Source note: Karnataka State Government guarantee scheme (Gruha Lakshmi). Facts curated for GramSakhi grounding from official state scheme descriptions.
